verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's Codex offers a CLI and SDK explicitly documented for headless/CI use ('Use the Codex SDK to automate coding tasks, including jobs in CI'), plus CLI flags (--search, /fast) and a bulk-scan command (npx @openai/codex-security bulk-scan) that support non-interactive automation workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of actual CI pipeline runs, and more detail on authentication/headless setup specifics for CI environments.
